notes.title: Beat 'Em Up Collection Update
notes.content: [p]Hello, street fighters! We have some news about the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649306/fe5578b0eab25106a9aa779a4ad832440ea7b2cd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]1 - An option has been added to the settings allowing players to enable or disable the rewind feature.[/p][p]2 - A written interview (in the trivia section) and over 60 images have been added to the Gourmet Sentai game gallery section.[/p][p]Have fun and keep fighting![/p]

notes.title: Beat ’Em Up Collection is Out Now!
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="XVqzPo22vUQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]

Hi guys![/b][/p][p]Get ready for a retro rampage! [b]Beat 'Em Up Collection (QUByte Classics)[/b] is officially available on Steam starting today![/p][p]This action-packed bundle includes 7 side-scrolling beat 'em up classics, each carefully preserved and updated with modern features like rewind, save states, visual filters, digital manuals, and full control remapping. 
[/p][p][b]What's in the Collection?[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]🗡️ First Samurai:[/b] A mystical warrior battles through time to defeat an evil wizard. Platforming meets fast-paced sword combat in this eastern fantasy classic from the 16-bit era.[/p][/*][*][p][b]⚔️ Second Samurai:[/b] Time-traveling sequel to First Samurai. With richer visuals and co-op play, you’ll fight through ancient, medieval, and futuristic worlds to stop chaos from spreading.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🍗 Gourmet Warriors:[/b] A bizarre beat 'em up set in a dystopian future where food is power. Battle mutant chefs and culinary-themed enemies in this over-the-top cult classic.[/p][/*][*][p]💥 [b]Iron Commando:[/b] Once lost to time, now revived. Join two elite fighters as they clean up the streets using fists, blades, and even motorcycles. Explosive action from start to finish.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🐉 Legend:[/b] A medieval-themed beat 'em up where knights clash with monsters. Wield your sword against evil in a beautifully animated journey for justice and glory.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🛡️ Sword of Sodan:[/b] Known for its massive character sprites and gritty fantasy world, this classic brings dark magic, brutal combat, and raw 16-bit power to your screen.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🌪️ The Tale of Clouds and Winds:[/b] An ultra-rare Chinese martial arts beat 'em up featuring mythological enemies and traditional art. A hidden gem finally getting the spotlight it deserves.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]
Collection Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]✅ Rewind function[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Save/load anytime[/p][/*][*][p]✅ CRT and scanline filters[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Digital game manuals[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Fully remappable controls[/p][/*][*][p]✅ Menu languages: English, Portuguese (BR), Spanish[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Available now with a launch discount for a limited time![/b][/p][p][/p]
